problem: The personal LinkedIn daily obligation ended as SKIPPED/NO_ELIGIBLE_CONTENT after the fallback selected the already-consumed printer story family. A later compliant replacement recommendation could not recover the day because the orchestrator treated skipped as terminal and only accepted verified first-person personal sources.
root_cause: Three contracts drifted apart: legacy no-gap rotation reused historical personal artifacts; the identity/truth policy correctly forbade semantic story-family reuse; and the orchestrator preserved skipped state while requiring first-person truth. Multiple active LinkedIn connections also made provider account selection less deterministic. A fourth defect let skipped recommendations remain eligible for personal-source ranking, allowing a higher-priority rejected source to resurrect.
decision: Never recycle historical personal anecdotes to satisfy cadence. When no genuinely unused verified personal event exists, use a fresh source-backed everyday-life observation with no first-person claim, no business bridge and full lineage. A personal NO_ELIGIBLE_CONTENT skip is recoverable whenever such a compliant source becomes available. Personal provider resolution must prefer the canonical personal LinkedIn connection.
prevention: Historical generated personal artifacts are ineligible as no-gap fallback sources.
Observational fallback requires a fresh source URL, source lineage, personal-life topic and zero first-person experience claims.
Semantic/story-family uniqueness remains mandatory before provider write.
SKIPPED/NO_ELIGIBLE_CONTENT is not terminal for the daily personal obligation when a compliant new source exists.
The orchestrator, pre-publish gate and publisher share the same truth-mode distinction.
LinkedIn personal connection resolution prefers linkedin-personal-canonical-current and still verifies the actual member ID.
Personal-source ranking must filter to status suggested/accepted before priority scoring; skipped/blocked/rejected recommendations are permanently ineligible for that run.
